interview.q: What are the relationship types in Eloquent?
interview.a: One to one, one to many, many to many, has-many-through, aur polymorphic (one to many, many to many).
Loop mein har record ke liye alag relation query chalna. `with()` se eager loading karke solve karte hain.
`has` existence/ginti check karta hai. `whereHas` relation par custom condition lagata hai.
Many-to-many ke liye beech ki table jisme dono tables ke foreign keys (aur extra data) hote hain.
Ek child model jo kai alag parent model types se `_id` aur `_type` columns se jud sakta hai.

interview.q: How do you prevent N+1 during development?
interview.a: `Model::preventLazyLoading(! app()->isProduction())` se lazy loading par exception, aur `with()` se eager loading.
